stem: Which plant response would best aid a plant in maximizing and retaining water acquired during a drought?

options.label: A
options.text: Decreasing root growth, while increasing stem and leaf growth

options.label: B
options.text: Increasing root, stem, and leaf growth

options.label: C
options.text: Decreasing stem and leaf growth, while increasing root growth

options.label: D
options.text: Increasing leaf and root growth, while decreasing stem growth
